title: Climate (Koppen)
blurb: The Koppen climate groups of India, state by state.
source: Koppen climate groups for India as given in IMD and NCERT texts (sources differ on the number of types), summarised by state
licence: Public facts (IMD and NCERT-style texts), summarised by state; approximate
note: Shaded by the main climate of each state. A state can hold several types.

types.name: Am: tropical monsoon
types.also: Western coast, Kerala, Goa, islands, parts of the north-east.

types.name: Aw: tropical savanna
types.also: Most of the peninsular interior: hot, dry winter.

types.name: BSh: hot semi-arid steppe
types.also: Rain-shadow belt east of the Western Ghats, Punjab, Haryana, Gujarat.

types.name: Cwa: humid subtropical
types.also: Gangetic plain and north-east: dry winter, hot wet summer.

types.name: Highland (E): alpine and Himalayan
types.also: Himalayan states: climate changes with altitude.

types.name: Cold desert
types.also: Ladakh and Spiti: very dry, cold.
